ios.desc:
Swipe to merge. Brew potions. Don't let the grid fill up.

Merge Mixology is a one-handed puzzle game where four-directional swipes slide and merge magical ingredients into ever-more-powerful potions. Easy to pick up for 2 minutes. Hard to put down.

HOW IT WORKS
Swipe up, down, left, or right to push all tiles on a 4×4 grid. When two matching ingredients collide, they fuse into the next tier — a humble Dewdrop becomes a Shimmering Leaf, which becomes Sprite Dust, and onward toward the legendary Sylvan Panacea.

Customers visit your potion stand with orders. When a tile glows, tap it to fulfill the order and trigger a mystery effect — gold rush, gift tiles, a board-clearing blast, or something far less convenient.

THE HOLDING FLASK
Long-press any tile to tuck it away for safekeeping. Retrieve it when the moment is right. But don't leave it too long — ingredients don't like waiting.

EARN, SPEND, REPEAT
Every run earns gold. Between runs, spend it in the shop on starting boosts: kick off with a powerful Tier 4 tile already on the board, freeze new spawns for your first few moves, or guarantee an order appears immediately. Each run feels different.

FEATURES
· Satisfying 2048-style merge mechanics with a magical twist
· Strategic order system with mystery effects — good and bad
· Holding Flask for tactical tile storage
· Undo button to rewind a bad swipe
· Blast lifeline to clear the board when you're stuck
· Gold shop with run-start boosts
· Escalating merge animations and haptics that feel great
· Portrait, one-handed — built for the thumb zone
· Play offline, no internet required

No energy timers. No pay-to-win. One optional $2.99 purchase removes ads entirely.

Can you brew The Sylvan Panacea?
